verdict.rationale: Windmill documents a low-code flow builder for assembling steps into multi-step flows, with branches and per-step retries configurable in the flow. However, the flow steps are scripts written in code, so the 'without writing code' part is only partly met for an ops user. missing for 10: evidence that an ops user can build a complete workflow with no code (pre-built no-code step library or connectors), screenshots or docs of the visual flow editor in depth, independent hands-on corroboration of non-developer use.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build multi-step workflows in a visual editor without writing code

citations.quote: An orchestrator for assembling these functions into efficient, low-latency flows, using either a low-code builder or YAML
Windmill supports both UI-based operations via its webIDE and low-code builders
Scripts are turned into sharable UIs automatically, and can be composed together into flows
Branches allow to split the execution of the flow based on a condition.
